'''Model 19 micro-gravity well mine''' were a model of [[Gravity mine/Legends|gravity mine]], devices that were used to create [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity wells]] and pull [[Starship/Legends|starships]] out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The mines were produced by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and sold for 3,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
